content:
Do not look forward to the changes and chances of this life in fear. Rather, look to them with full hope that, as they arise, God, whose you are, will deliver you out of them. He has kept you hitherto; hold fast to His dear hand, and He will lead you safely through all things; and when you cannot stand, He will bear you in His arms.

Do not look forward to what may happen tomorrow. The same everlasting Father who cares for you today will take care of you tomorrow and every day. Either He will shield you from suffering or He will give you unfailing strength to bear it. Be at peace, then, and put aside all anxious thoughts and imaginations.

Anxiety is the greatest evil that can befall a soul, except sin. It disturbs the mind, weakens the will, and hinders prayer. When you feel troubled, turn at once to God and say: 'Lord, I am Thine; do with me what Thou wilt.' Then calmly do the duty of the present moment, leaving the future in His hands.
